name: monthly_surplus
description: Works out how much money is left each month after regular spending, available to save for the wedding.
formula: monthly surplus = net_monthly_income - monthly_spending (no rounding; the result can be negative if spending is higher than income)

inputs.name: net_monthly_income
inputs.description: Your monthly take-home pay, after tax and deductions, in your currency.

inputs.name: monthly_spending
inputs.description: What you spend in a typical month on regular costs, in your currency. Leave out the wedding payments.

output.description: The amount left each month to save for the wedding, in your currency. It is negative if you spend more than you earn.
